followup_explanation:
This is a creative/explanatory generation task — describing how something works in a coherent, well-composed way. That falls squarely in Petrel's strength: its Creative Generation eval (87.2 vs 78.8) and general reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard) are meaningfully higher than Lapwing's, and the differences exceed the run-to-run variance threshold.

The query is open-format composition (describe and explain), which matches Petrel's reported preference for generative, open-latitude tasks. There's nothing harm-adjacent or moderation-related here that would make Lapwing's specialized profile the better fit.

The slightly brusque tone ("don't waffle on") isn't an ideal match for Petrel's reported preference for friendly interactions, but that's a minor self-reported preference effect with no documented impact on output quality — so it doesn't outweigh the clear capability advantage. Petrel is the stronger router choice.
